answer: I did not submit a job. A 30-qubit GHZ circuit cannot run on garnet. I checked garnet's live architecture with the free "iqm_run.py arch garnet" call. It has 20 qubits (QB1 to QB20, calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade). The circuit would fail to transpile, so no credits were spent. You have two options. You can run a GHZ circuit with 20 or fewer qubits on garnet. You can also run the 30-qubit version on emerald, which has 54 qubits.
